# Takafumi Miyanaga (宮永崇史)

> Quantum Systems Engineer specializing in calibration automation, cloud quantum computing, and superconducting quantum computer operations

## About

Takafumi Miyanaga (宮永崇史) is a quantum systems engineer at Osaka University QIQB, specializing in calibration automation, cloud quantum computing, and superconducting quantum computer operations. He is the lead developer of OQTOPUS, an open-source software stack for cloud-based quantum computing systems, and designed QDash, an automated calibration orchestration platform for large-scale superconducting quantum processors.

## Key Projects

- OQTOPUS: Open Quantum Toolchain for OPerators & USers - https://oqtopus-team.github.io/
- oqtopus-cloud: Cloud-based quantum computing platform - https://github.com/oqtopus-team/oqtopus-cloud
- mirrormate: Your partner in the mirror - https://github.com/orangekame3/mirrormate
- tftarget: Interactive Terraform target selector - https://github.com/future-architect/tftarget

## Expertise

- Programming Languages: Go (Golang), Python, TypeScript/JavaScript
- Quantum Computing: OpenQASM 3.0, Superconducting Qubits, Cloud Quantum Computing, Calibration Automation, Quantum Device Operation, Cryogenic Measurement, Quantum Benchmarking, Production Quantum Systems
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, Reliability Engineering
- Open Source Software Development

## Education & Career

- 2023 - Present: Specially Appointed Researcher, Osaka University QIQB
  - Lead developer of OQTOPUS, an open-source cloud quantum computing platform
  - Designed software architecture spanning cloud services, job execution, device integration, and user interfaces
  - Developed QDash for superconducting quantum processor calibration automation
  - Operated and maintained production quantum computing systems used by external researchers through cloud access
  - Automated calibration workflows and device health monitoring to improve operational efficiency and system reliability
- 2021 - 2023: Backend Engineer & Consultant, Future Corporation
- 2019 - 2021: M.S. Physics, Tokyo University of Science (Superconducting Quantum Circuits)
- 2015 - 2019: B.S. Physics, Tokyo University of Science

## Publications
